description: Zsyio Suite is an integrated enterprise operational operating system engineered to eliminate corporate SaaS fragmentation. Instead of juggling disconnected silos across Jira, Notion, Salesforce, BambooHR, and Okta, Zsyio consolidates engineering sprint execution, knowledge documentation, sales CRM pipelines, workforce HRMS, and identity governance into a unified, high-density platform.
features: Turborepo Monorepo Architecture: pnpm workspaces orchestrating 5 specialized apps and 5 shared enterprise packages.
Zsyio Flow (PMS): Interactive sprint Kanban, stopwatch time tracking, AI task summaries, and Git branch generators.
Zsyio Canvas (Docs): Tiptap GFM editor with live Mermaid.js SVG architecture diagrams and incident runbooks.
Zsyio Pulse (CRM): Deal pipeline tracking stage velocities, revenue metrics, client touchpoints, and lead directories.
Zsyio People (HRMS): Attendance punch station, daily timesheets, leave quotas, and presence roster compliance.
Zsyio Console (IAM): Central Zero-Trust identity governance, 56-action granular RBAC matrix, and department hierarchies.

solutions: Corporate SaaS Consolidation (Replaces Jira, Notion, Salesforce, BambooHR, and Okta with a single high-performance workspace).
Cross-Application Workflow Synergy (Won deals trigger client sprint backlogs; delivery tickets reference live RFC docs).
Capacity-Aware Sprint Planning (Engineering velocity automatically factors in live team attendance and approved leave quotas).
Unified Zero-Trust Security (A single session and 56-action RBAC matrix enforced across every micro-application).

cross_app_integrations.description: Closed-Won deals in Zsyio Pulse automatically scaffold client accounts and delivery sprint backlogs in Zsyio Flow.
Engineering tickets in Zsyio Flow embed and bi-directionally sync with technical specs and ADRs authored in Zsyio Canvas.
Sprint workload distribution in Zsyio Flow factors in live team attendance, shift intervals, and approved leaves from Zsyio People.
Tenant context, authentication, and the 56-action RBAC matrix are universally enforced across all ports by Zsyio Console.
